title: Postcard and Songbook
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Juniper Joubert, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
